description_en: Creates a live stream transcoding template, which can be referenced when submitting a transcoding job
description_zh: 调用本接口创建实时转码模板，便于提交实时转码任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-live-transcode-template --type normal --name my_template --template-config '{"AudioParams":{"Codec":"AAC","Bitrate":"100","Samplerate":"44100","Channels":"2","Profile":"aaclow"},"VideoParams":{"Codec":"H.264","Fps":"25","Gop":"1000","Height":"720","Width":"1280","Bitrate":"2500","Profile":"2"}}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveTranscodeTemplate

parameters.description_en:
The type of the template. Valid values:

- normal

- narrow-band

- audio-only

- origin
parameters.description_zh:
模版类型。
- normal - 普通
- narrow-band - 窄高
- audio-only - 纯音频
- origin - 原画

parameters.description_zh:
模版配置。
> 针对不同的模板类型（Type）的传参要求，参数填写规则如下：当Type的值为normal时，宽和高参数中至少需要填写一个，同时帧率和码率参数为必填项；对于其他类型的模板，需根据具体需求填写相应的参数。

fields.description_en:
The height of the output video. Valid values: Height ≥ 128 max (Height,Width) ≤ 2560 min (Height,Width) ≤ 1440

Note: The resolution of the output video that is transcoded by using the H.265 Narrowband HD transcoding template cannot exceed 1280 × 720 pixels.

fields.description_en: The encoding profile. The profile determines how a video is encoded. In most cases, a greater value indicates better image quality and higher resource consumption. Valid values: 1: baseline. This value is suitable for mobile devices. 2: main. This value is suitable for standard-definition devices. 3: high. This value is suitable for high-definition devices.
fields.description_zh:
编码级别。视频支持的一组特定的编码功能，一般值越大得到的画面质量越好，同时编解码消耗的资源也越高。取值：

- 1：baseline（适合移动设备）。

- 2：main（适合标准分辨率设备）。

- 3：high（适合高分辨率设备）。
